_about: Weights for src/score. How to tune: docs/scoring-notes.md. Every change gets a line in _changes with its reason.
_changes: 2026-10-15 first weights (M2), from PLAN.md's first-ranking signals
2026-10-15 clusterGapSeconds 6 -> 12: the hand-picked round-8 3k on the October de_inferno demo (M0 interval B) has kills 11.5 s and 9.0 s apart and fell apart into three single kills at 6
2026-10-15 includeOvertime false: PLAN.md section 3 excludes overtime rounds; set true to rank them
2026-10-15 per-round moments (Peder): all of his kills in a round are one moment, so clusterGapSeconds is gone; quick succession is a scoring signal instead

2026-10-15 tightness: the most kills inside any windowSeconds (6 s) earn perKillInWindow each beyond the first, all kills within allWithinSeconds earn allWithinBonus, and speed now scores the tightest run, so a 3k in 4 s beats a 3k over 40 s by about 30 points (Peder: quick succession is worth more)

2026-10-15 light signals (Peder: a small bonus each, never enough to lift a weak round over a strong one): noscope moved from flags into light, airborne (attackerinair), one-bullet kills, flicks (yaw turned in the 100-200 ms before the kill shot above minDegrees); capped together at maxPerMoment, below the 20-point gap between kill counts

2026-10-15 recalibrated (Peder: keep minScore 40; anchor: the moments that scored about 40 in the 46-moment batch must land about 40 again, and a plain 2k must not gain a flat 18): tightness pays only from the third kill in the 6 s window (perKillBeyondTwo 15), allWithin bonus removed; a 2k scores as before (its pace is in speed), a 3k in 4 s still beats a 3k over 40 s by about 19

speed._note: scored on the tightest run (the best tightness window), not the whole round

tightness._note: kills in quick succession: each kill beyond the second inside the best windowSeconds window; a 2k's pace is already in speed

light._note: small bonuses, capped together at maxPerMoment; kill count, pace, clutch and outcome stay the backbone
